title: About the Author
text: ABOUT THE AUTHOR © Lori Barra Born in Peru and raised in Chile, Isabel Allende is the author of a number of bestselling and critically acclaimed books, including The House of the Spirits , Eva Luna , Stories of Eva Luna , Of Love and Shadows , and Paula . Her latest novel is The Japanese Lover . Her books have been translated into more than thirty-five languages and have sold over sixty-five million copies worldwide. She lives in California.
